OUR CULINARY STORY

EXPERIENCE THE Authentic Taste OF DEHRADUN

Welcome to Fork & Knife (फोर्क & नाइफ), Garhi Cantt’s beloved cozy cafe where every dish tells a story of care and authenticity. Renowned for freshly prepared comfort foods, handcrafted momos, and indulgent pastas, our kitchen takes pride in serving quality flavours that satisfy your appetite and warm your soul.
